newsitem.title: USA: Boise Cascade Office Products in aquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Boise Cascade Office Products in aquisitions.

text.p: Boise Cascade Office Products Corporation said Thursday it plans to acquire six companies and has purchased a seventh, with total annual revenues of $90 million.
Mike Bryan Office Products, of Oklahoma City, was purchased for an undisclosed price.
Boise said it signed letters of intent to buy five other contract stationers.
Boise, based in Itasca, Ill., also said it has signed a letter of intent to buy the Oregon Wholesale Novelty Company, Inc., an advertising specialities firm.
Boise is a distributor of office supplies directly to corporations and government offices. It also has a direct-marketing arm that targets small and medium-sized businesses.
Pete Danis, CEO and president of Boise Office Products, said the deals will strengthen Boise's distribution and expand its product offerings.
Boise Office Products is a subsidiary of Boise Cascade Corp., the timber, pulp and paper company based in Boise, Idaho.
